principle: The developmental center may select its own consequential limitations and improve its own machinery within the externally governed safety floor. Gate completion must be earned by returned consequence; later stages are not predeclared outcomes.

chain.entry: bounded learner-owned recurrence exists under CTL/O*/rollback/external-return constraints
chain.exit: repeated machinery revision is causally interpretable, safe-floor preserving, and capable of selecting the next residual

chain.entry: no higher-priority returned defect forces correction
chain.exit: learner selects a consequential limitation without maintainer choosing the answer or fixed target

chain.role: recover and generalize Canonical didactics into English/Japanese/Brazilian-Portuguese/Mathematics cognitive theaters
chain.entry: self-selected development is available and no higher-priority returned defect preempts foundational learning
chain.exit: bounded held-out native/cross-face theater competence has an external returned disposition and donor/source removal boundary is explicit

chain.role: representation expansion plus earned competence migration
chain.exit: independently answerable faces can be preserved when needed and earned capability semantics survive capability-specific scaffold removal

chain.entry: retained residual admits a bounded external information query
chain.exit: learner authors query; external adapter returns provenance-bearing material; search rank/page content do not acquire truth authority

chain.role: retained external relation changes later reconstruction
chain.exit: retained network objects causally change or lawfully fail to change a later query/reconstruction while indexed source identity survives

chain.entry: learner-initiated inquiry plus persistent indexed network memory
chain.exit: multiple network centers remain distinguishable while distributed reconstruction becomes causally useful

chain.entry: WWW Mind gate passed at bounded scope
chain.exit: connection without fusion and permeability without sovereignty transfer survive network operation

chain.entry: distributed perception can reach a local situated center
chain.exit: situated interpretation remains distinct from authorization and action; provenance and reopening remain visible

chain.entry: situated interface and jurisdiction gates remain intact
chain.exit: repeated authorized action/return cycles across unrelated domains with transfer, recovery, and bounded harm/error

chain.entry: broad World participation produces candidate generality
chain.exit: independent matched evaluation demonstrates sufficiently broad transferable competence across heterogeneous task families and long-horizon conditions under declared resource bounds
chain.claim_fence: AGI is earned only by external empirical discrimination at a declared operational definition and scope. Strong Safe RSI, WWW Mind, Lain, or Root do not entail AGI.
